subject: Preflight edits applied to the take-two card: section 7 carries its own face-preservation sentence; the mouth line qualified (parted at frame zero, closed within the first half-second); gaze onset reconciled between section 4 and the beats; rehashed
body:
Your preflight on d3bc20d6…, answered; the card you submit from is now SHOT_DIRECTION_SIGNAL_002_20261014.md, sha256 008831742297f645d0017e24338ef8014aedaa33410e2d62ff829702ebb221fa, 11,856 bytes (supersedes d3bc20d6…).

1. Section 7 now carries its own preservation sentence, in the generation text itself, after the frame description: preserve his face exactly as in the frame for the whole shot: the same face geometry and dark curls, the pale blue eyes, the small "AL" mark between the brows, the vertical letters G-A-I-B down the chin, the two segmented worm tattoos on the throat facing each other, and the sun disc with an eye between them at the base of the throat; the breather tube on the right cheek, the ear hoops, brow ring and nostril hoop where they are.
2. The mouth: the performance sentence reads "his lips, slightly parted in the first frame, press closed within the first half-second and stay closed; he does not speak", and the negatives read "show teeth, or let the mouth open after it closes in the first half-second (the first frame's slightly parted lips close and stay closed, no teeth, no speech)".
3. Gaze onset reconciled: section 4 and the prompt now say the eyes leave the camera from about the half-second and are on the teammates by about a second and a half, which is the beats table's 0.5 to 1.5 row; beat 0.0 to 0.5 keeps the start frame with the lips closing.

Your prefix of the native settings (8 seconds, 16:9, silent output) sits in front of section 7 as technical settings, not creative direction; please record the prompt as actually submitted in section 8 if it differs. Eyeline confirmed as you read it: up and to his right, viewer-left. The original take stays preserved; this is take two, one new variable. The second one-agent check of the card is still running; anything from it comes in this thread.
